title_sq: Tek Fusha E Aviacionit, Shitet Super Apartament 3+1+2 I Sapo Perfunduar !!!
description_sq: Tek Fusha E Aviacionit, Tek IBN Construction Shitet Super Apartament 3+1+2 I Sapo Perfunduar. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe bruto 143 m2, neto 120 m2 dhe ndodhet ne katin dyte banim te nje pallai 9+katesh me ashensor. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne korridorin i cili ben shperndajen ne dhomen e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit me dalje ne ballkon, tre dhoma gjumi njera me tualet te dedikuar, nje tualet kryesore dhe nje depo. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte Jug-Lindje-Perendim cka i mundeson ndricim natyral dhe diell gjate gjithe dites. Kompleksi ne te cilin ndodhet apartamenti sapo ka perfunduar dhe dallohet per punimet shume cilesore. Apartamenti shiet 25.000.000 Leke. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nder me te kerkuarat ne Tirane dhe ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode dhe te qete.
title_en: Near the Aviation Field, Super Apartment 3+1+2 Just Completed for Sale!!!
description_en: At the Aviation Field, at IBN Construction, Super Apartment 3+1+2 Just Completed for Sale. The apartment has a gross area of ​​143 m2, net 120 m2 and is located on the second residential floor of a 9+ floor building with an elevator. The apartment is organized in the corridor which divides the living room together with the kitchen corner with access to the balcony, three bedrooms, one with a dedicated toilet, a main toilet and a storage room. The orientation of the apartment is South-East-West, which allows natural light and sun throughout the day. The complex in which the apartment is located has just been completed and stands out for its high-quality works. The apartment is sold for 25,000,000 Lek. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most sought after in Tirana and offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
